page.overview:
Who is Barger?

Barger was an alien cyborg who worked for Imperial Security Bureau Director Orson Krennic during the Imperial Era. In 1 BBY, Barger kept an eye out for the defected Imperial cargo pilot Bodhi Rook for Krennic near the Ring of Kafrene mining colony and contacted Krennic when a UT-60D U-wing starfighter/support craft using falsified credentials arrived at the colony.

Krennic had Barger try and capture the starship's pilot, the rebel Cassian Andor, on the Ring of Kafrene, and the cyborg grabbed him in the colony's fry-market. Andor and Barger fought until Andor's companion, the KX-series security droid K-2SO, hurled Barger to the ground and crushed the alien's head with his foot, killing them.

Barger was a male alien cyborg who sold falsified starship credentials during the reign of the Galactic Empire. After the Imperial cargo pilot Bodhi Rook in the Outer Rim's Thand sector where the director thought Rook might surface. Barger waited in a starship in the Kafrene asteroid belt around the colony and contacted Krennic via hologram when a UT-60D U-wing starfighter/support craft using one of the cyborg's falsified credentials arrived at Kafrene.

Barger informed Krennic about the vessel but could not confirm if Rook was on board or not, only that the falsified credentials suggested someone who was wanted by the law. Krennic demanded that Barger bring the U-wing's crew to him, and the cyborg managed to track down the vessel's pilot, the rebel intelligence officer Cassian Andor, on the Ring of Kafrene. Barger observed Andor using the blaster gas cartridge from his blaster pistol to create a distraction for Imperial stormtroopers while the rebel was recovering a comlink from a drop site in the colony's fry-market.
